model.name: drawer.selectionDriven
model.description: R20.6g: consolidate 3 drawer paths (chat-sheet, detail-drawer, file-preview) into 1 selection-driven drawer. SelectionModel count drives content: 0=chat, 1=detail/preview, N=multi-detail. RoomView no longer owns drawer switching — SelectionModel events do. Direct-write drawer body from selection handler (S1/S2/D1/D2/D3 from req).
